description: Recompilation can omit tensors present only in an override source.
trigger: Select an override group whose tensor-name set adds a key absent from the original group, for example an MCG-encoded replacement adding .mcg.
expected_behavior: The materialized replacement includes its required companion tensors, or the utility rejects incompatible key sets.
actual_behavior: Variant get_tensor_sizes and get_tensors enumerate only main.tensor_file_map. The replacement-only key is neither counted nor emitted. Linear.load_exl3 treats absent .mcg as optional, and LinearEXL3 stores a zero multiplier when it is missing.

verification.description: Traced the new utility through compiler prefix enumeration and compared existing variant callers in model_init and model_diff. The observation concerns differing key sets, not same-key substitutions.
verification.limits: No actual mixed-codebook checkpoint or inference output was tested.

verification.description: Modeled original-key enumeration with a replacement-only .mcg key and calculated the omitted four-byte contribution.
verification.limits: Python dictionary arithmetic only; no safetensors or repository implementation executed.

introductions.rationale: The new recompilation utility introduces this reachable assembly path; collection/compiler behavior is traced in the accepted finding.
